title: Rav Sheshet of Kartiza
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Megillah 21b: he came to Rav Ashi’s house and recited the blessings M-N-Ch. Hyman reports that the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim read: “he came before Rav Sheshet.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Megillah 21b has Rav Sheshet of Katarzya before Rav Ashi and the mnemonic מנ״ח for the three blessings before Megillah reading. Hyman’s Kartiza spelling, “house” wording, and reported Rif/Dikdukei Soferim alternative before Rav Sheshet are retained.

The whole Davidson paragraph names Rav Sheshet of Katarzya before Rav Ashi and gives מנ״ח. Hyman’s Kartiza, “house” and reported alternative remain distinct. The inherited note is verbatim; neither the Rif nor Dikdukei Soferim was freshly collated.
